retained_differences: scaled LKM 2 layers/128 hidden/4 heads and PromEnc 1 layer rather than 8/256/8 and 4
downstream batch 512 rather than 64 for local throughput; same for every variant
student-disjoint 70/15/15 holdout rather than 80/20 with fivefold CV
one true multi-concept event retained with mean concept embedding; no duplicated answer events
difficulty calculated on training only to avoid heldout response leakage
bounded training budget with recorded stopping criterion
one dataset and three initialization seeds rather than the full paper benchmark
